name: Signed-out visitors see the SocialFlow sign-in screen
description: Verifies visitors without a session are asked to sign in before seeing any workspace data.
steps: Open the app while signed out
expected: The SocialFlow name, email and password fields, and a Sign in button are visible.

name: Sign-in screen works on mobile
description: Verifies the sign-in screen fits a phone screen without horizontal scrolling.
steps: Open the app on a mobile viewport while signed out
expected: The SocialFlow name and email/password sign-in form are fully visible without horizontal scrolling.

name: Signed-out users can register and sign in
description: Verifies the app can create an account and establish a same-origin session.
steps: Open the app while signed out
Submit a valid name, email and password
expected: The visitor is signed in and the app opens the workspace onboarding flow.
